c74object.name: maxforge.sync
c74object.digest: Connect Max to maxforge MCP and synchronize a live patcher
c74object.description: Connect Max to maxforge MCP, synchronize a live patcher, and report debounced structural edit observations while connected. Observations exclude maxforge-authored plan application and do not represent Max undo actions or human intent.

method.name: register
method.digest: Register the containing patcher with the MCP bridge
method.description: Register the containing patcher with the MCP bridge

method.name: inspect
method.digest: Output a structural snapshot of the containing patcher
method.description: Output a structural snapshot of the containing patcher

method.name: validate
method.digest: Validate a compact JSON PatchPlan without mutating the patcher
method.description: Validate a compact JSON PatchPlan without mutating the patcher

method.name: applydict
method.digest: Validate and apply a named Max dictionary
method.description: Validate and apply a named Max dictionary

method.name: apply
method.digest: Validate and apply a compact JSON PatchPlan
method.description: Validate and apply a compact JSON PatchPlan

method.name: connect
method.digest: Connect to the maxforge MCP WebSocket bridge
method.description: Connect to the maxforge MCP WebSocket bridge

method.name: disconnect
method.digest: Disconnect from the maxforge MCP WebSocket bridge
method.description: Disconnect from the maxforge MCP WebSocket bridge

method.name: restart
method.digest: Restart the maxforge MCP WebSocket connection
method.description: Restart the maxforge MCP WebSocket connection

method.name: status
method.digest: Output the maxforge MCP WebSocket connection status
method.description: Output the maxforge MCP WebSocket connection status

attribute.name: host
attribute.description: maxforge MCP WebSocket host; non-loopback addresses require a token

attribute.name: token
attribute.digest: Shared token required for LAN connections
attribute.description: Shared URL-safe token sent before registration; required for non-loopback hosts

attribute.name: reconnect
attribute.digest: Automatically reconnect to the maxforge MCP bridge
attribute.description: Automatically reconnect to the maxforge MCP bridge

attribute.name: patcher_id
attribute.digest: Stable MCP routing ID for the containing patcher
attribute.description: Stable MCP routing ID for the containing patcher

attribute.name: controller
attribute.digest: Allow this patcher to create or open top-level patches
attribute.description: Allow correlated MCP requests to create an unsaved top-level patch or open a Max-host .maxpat and inject one maxforge.sync object
